messages.subject: Senior Leadership Interest | Director, Market Operations & Facilities Management | Saudi Arabia
messages.body:
Dear Aishwarya,

I am writing in response to Mindfield Resources' current Saudi Arabia mandate for Director, Market Operations & Facilities Management.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, where my mandate spans country-facing leadership, asset-intensive operating coordination, government and regulatory relations, business continuity, ESG, stakeholder strategy and executive delivery. My background includes multinational mining, regulated banking and commercial operations, with current responsibilities requiring coordinated execution across operations, HSE, environment, finance, procurement, legal, security, aviation, logistics and technical teams.

My sector experience is rooted in mining rather than central markets or fresh-food operations. The strongest alignment lies in leading complex, high-accountability operating environments, coordinating infrastructure and logistics interfaces, managing supplier and contractor ecosystems, resolving regulatory and stakeholder constraints, and converting business requirements into accountable cross-functional execution. My earlier banking and account-management experience adds commercial, client, risk and financial-control discipline.

I am interested in this Saudi mandate and in adjacent GCC executive opportunities where asset operations, country execution, government relations, commercial discipline and stakeholder leadership are central. I am internationally mobile, open to relocation across Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached a tailored executive CV for your review. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding this mandate or other senior leadership opportunities aligned with my background.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
